name: ClassOne Technology
old_description: Electroplating and Wet Processing for Advanced Microelectronics
about:
ClassOne Technology is headquartered in Kalispell, Montana, where it designs and manufactures electroplating and wet‑processing equipment for advanced microelectronics. The company operates as ClassOne Technology Inc. and serves the semiconductor industry from its facility at 109 Cooperative Way. No founding year or founders are disclosed.

The company’s product line centers on the Solstice platform, offered in two configurations: the Solstice Max for 200 mm and 300 mm wafers (2–16 chambers) and the Solstice S‑Series for 3‑inch to 200 mm wafers (2–8 chambers). Both platforms are modular and field‑extendable. The equipment portfolio includes dedicated process chambers: the GoldPro™ Chamber, CopperMax™ Chamber, and Gen4 ECD Chamber for electroplating; a Wet Etch Chamber; and a Solvent & MLO Chamber for surface preparation. These chambers support a range of processes — copper TSV fill, copper RDL and pillar plating, multi‑metal stack pillars, advanced gold plating (including TWV, patterned, deplating, and fine‑feature fill), photoresist strip, metal lift‑off, UBM and patterned metal wet etch, RCA cleans (SC1/SC2), piranha (SPM), and emerging applications such as through‑glass vias, indium bump plating, and hybrid bonding.

ClassOne’s systems target advanced packaging houses, RF and sensor manufacturers, high‑reliability device makers, photonics and advanced‑sensor developers, and compound‑ and power‑semiconductor fabs. The company positions its tools for both production and R&D environments, emphasizing flexibility across a broad set of backend applications.

ClassOne states that its differentiator lies in removing “unnecessary complexity common to competitors” in favor of “more elegant and intuitive designs,” which it says yields faster recipe dial‑in, longer uptime, and lower operator and engineering burden. The platform is described as a common, easy‑to‑use, high‑performance foundation that maximizes performance relative to complexity and cost.
